models.priceHint: Prices apply to every key and only affect future charges.
models.priceTokenSummary: Input {{input}} · Output {{output}} · Cache read {{cache}} · Cache write {{write}} / 1M

balance.title: Prepaid balance
balance.noCredit: No credit yet; requests are refused until you add some
balance.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above 0 and up to {{max}}
balance.afterNotPositive: The balance will be zero or below: this key will be refused right away
balance.help: Every adjustment is written to the audit log. Usage is deducted at the charged amount; once the balance is used up requests get 429, and they resume as soon as credit is added.
balance.uncertain: The server did not confirm; the adjustment may already be applied. Retry: the same adjustment is applied only once.
balance.notBalanceMode: This key uses period quotas. Switch it to a prepaid balance on its edit page first.
balance.requestConflict: This adjustment was already submitted with a different amount. Close the dialog, check the balance and start again.
balance.refreshFailed: The balance was adjusted but the page could not refresh. Refresh it manually; do not repeat the adjustment.
balance.duplicate: This adjustment was already applied; nothing was applied twice
balance.afterThen: Balance right after that adjustment: {{amount}} (later spending not included)

modeHint.cycle: Spending is limited per day, 7 days and 30 days, and resets automatically.
modeHint.balance: An administrator adds credit; usage is deducted from it and stops when it runs out. It never resets on its own.

balance.switchClearsLimits: Switching to a prepaid balance clears the daily, 7-day and 30-day quotas; the balance becomes this key's only limit.
balance.switchStartsEmpty: After saving, usage is deducted from the kept {{amount}} balance.
balance.switchKeepsBalance: The {{amount}} balance is kept but no longer spent; it is used again if you switch back. Period quotas of 0 mean unlimited.
balance.currentOnEdit: Current balance {{amount}}. Adjust it from the list or the usage page; every adjustment is audited.
balance.initialHint: Written right after the key is created, and audited. Leave it empty to start at 0; requests are then refused until credit is added.
balance.initialFailed: The key was created but its starting balance was not written (the balance is still $0, so requests are refused). Add it here with “Adjust balance”.
balance.deleteDropsBalance: This key's {{amount}} balance is deleted with it (the audit log records it).
balance.historyMore: See all in the audit log
balance.periodModelsTitle: By model · spending in the period
balance.switchEmptyBalance: The balance is $0.00: after saving, this key is refused until you add credit with “Adjust balance” in the list or on the usage page.

channels.noAuthIndex: CPA has not loaded this credential (no auth_index), so it has no statistics yet.
channels.sharedAuthIndex: Shares its auth_index with {{name}}: CPA does not tell the two apart, so their requests are counted on that row.
channels.failuresTitle: {{failures}} of {{attempts}} attempts failed in the last 24 hours

channels.noUsage: Luobo has no usage records for this channel yet; statistics appear once it has served requests.

adapters.description: Rewrites the request body before an attempt goes to this channel; only that attempt is affected.
adapters.empty: This channel has no adapter rules.

type.edits_image_field: Image edits: use the image field

typeHint.edits_image_field: Moves the images of a JSON image edit from images[].image_url to the image field (a string for one image, an array for several) and removes images. Some new-api based upstreams need this; bodies that already have image are left alone.
typeHint.set_field: Sets a top-level field of the body. Without "Overwrite an existing value", it only fills a missing field.
typeHint.delete_field: Removes a top-level field from the body.

adapters.pathsHint: One CPA route per line, the pattern CPA registers rather than the URL, such as /v1/chat/completions. Codex CLI with chatgpt_base_url sends /backend-api/codex/responses, and Gemini requests arrive as /v1beta/models/*action. Required.
adapters.pathsDefaultHint: One CPA route per line, the pattern CPA registers rather than the URL. Codex CLI with chatgpt_base_url sends /backend-api/codex/responses, and Gemini requests arrive as /v1beta/models/*action. Empty uses the default {{paths}}.
adapters.pathsRequired: This type needs at least one request path.
adapters.valueHint: Write it as JSON: strings need quotes, such as "low"; numbers, true/false and objects as they are.
adapters.valueInvalid: The value is not valid JSON; strings need quotes.
adapters.toggleOnConfirm: Turn on this "{{type}}" rule? Requests to this channel on {{paths}} are rewritten from now on.
adapters.toggleOffConfirm: Turn off this "{{type}}" rule? Requests to this channel on {{paths}} are no longer rewritten from now on.
adapters.deleteConfirm: Delete this "{{type}}" rule? Requests to this channel will no longer be rewritten.
adapters.previewHint: Preview runs the rule inside Luobo and sends nothing.
adapters.previewBodyInvalid: The sample body must be a JSON object.
adapters.previewUnchanged: The rule leaves this body unchanged.
adapters.trySaveFirst: Save the rule first to send it for real.
adapters.tryConfirm: This sends one real request to the upstream and may cost money. A failure counts toward this channel's cooldown like real traffic. It is not billed to any downstream key.
adapters.trySavedVersion: The request uses the saved rule, without the unsaved changes in the form.
adapters.trying: Sending… (the upstream may take a while)
adapters.tryTruncated: The response is longer than 4096 characters; only the start is shown.
adapters.tryNotSeen: Luobo has not seen traffic on this channel yet, so it cannot pin the request to this credential. Try again after it has served real requests.
adapters.tryTimeout: No answer within {{minutes}} minutes. The page gave up on the request, which makes CPA cancel the upstream call.

search.title: Search
search.description: Chooses the model and channel for Codex web search (/v1/alpha/search): sessions on models outside the keep list switch to the target model, then go to the first healthy channel.
search.confirmOn: Luobo takes over routing for /v1/alpha/search, and CPA saves its configuration and re-applies it to every plugin once. If a probe key is saved, probes send real search requests at the configured interval, and those are paid. If alpha-search-model is still installed, disable it first so that two plugins do not both route searches.
search.confirmOff: Luobo stops registering its search router: CPA handles /v1/alpha/search on its own and probes stop. CPA saves its configuration and re-applies it to every plugin once.

stateHint.on: Luobo has registered its search router with CPA and chooses the model for alpha search.
stateHint.off: Luobo has no search router registered; CPA handles searches on its own.
stateHint.applying: The configuration is saved but the plugin's router registration has not caught up yet; this usually takes a few seconds.

search.applyingOn: Turning on: CPA is applying the configuration, {{seconds}} s of up to {{max}} s…
search.applyingOff: Turning off: CPA is applying the configuration, {{seconds}} s of up to {{max}} s…
search.timeoutOn: The configuration is saved (search_enabled = true), but the plugin had not registered its search router after {{max}} s. Refresh later; if it never takes effect, check the CPA log.
search.timeoutOff: The configuration is saved (search_enabled = false), but the plugin had not withdrawn its search router after {{max}} s. Refresh later; if it never takes effect, check the CPA log.
search.targetHint: Searches from sessions on models outside the keep list (such as Claude, Gemini or Grok) use this model.
search.keepHint: One pattern per line (such as gpt-*), case-insensitive; matching models are kept as they are.
search.channelsHint: Searches go to the first healthy channel. {model} in a template is replaced by the requested model, for example alphasearch-nb-{model}.
search.forceConfirm: Once forced, all searches go to "{{name}}". Takes effect when saved.
search.forceConfirmFallback: No other channel is usable: once forced, searches fall back to the first channel, "{{name}}". Takes effect when saved.
search.channelsRequired: At least one channel is required.
search.channelIncomplete: Every channel needs a name and a model template.
search.probeHint: A probe sends one short search through CPA's own /v1/alpha/search; failing channels are skipped until they recover.
search.probeIdleHint: Probes pause after this long without searches; 0 keeps probing.
search.probeKeyHint: Write-only: it is never shown again after saving.
search.probeKeyClear: Delete the saved key (turns probing off)
search.probeCost: At a {{interval}} s interval that is about {{count}} probes a day: while the primary channel is healthy each round probes only it, and later channels are probed only when it fails. Every probe is a real search request.
search.probeCostSingle: With a single channel there is nothing to probe.
search.probeCostNoKey: No probe key, so probing is off; channels only switch through "Force unhealthy".
search.intervalInvalid: The probe interval must be a whole number of seconds, at least {{min}}.
search.secondsInvalid: Timeout and idle pause must be whole seconds, the timeout at least 1.
search.leaveMessage: The search settings have changes that are not saved yet; leaving discards them.
search.importConfirm: Importing replaces the current search settings with the alpha-search-model plugin's configuration, including its probe key.
search.importEmpty: alpha-search-model has no configuration of its own in CPA (no block, or only CPA fields such as enabled and priority), so there is nothing to import. The current settings are unchanged.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Checks whether the model behind each credential was downgraded or substituted, with the candy puzzle, model fingerprints, ModelTrace and the pelican animation.
quality.about: Test requests go upstream through CPA and use the credentials' quota. They count as attempts in the channel statistics but are not billed to any downstream key.
quality.storageError: Test records are not being saved: {{error}}. Clear all records to keep the unreadable file under a new name and resume saving.
quality.configError: Cannot read CPA's config, so its API keys are not listed: {{error}}

intro.candy: The model solves a candy puzzle; answering {{answer}} is correct. Each request starts a new session with the full Codex CLI context.
intro.fingerprint: Collects how the model answers short questions and compares that distribution with fingerprints of genuine models to tell whether it was substituted. The result is statistical and does not prove a model's identity or ability on its own.
intro.modeltrace: The model writes three long integer sequences; their digit preferences and ordering identify the closest model family and version.
intro.pelican: The model writes an HTML page with an SVG animation of a pelican riding a bicycle.
intro.fingerprintSource: Method from the paper by Tomas Bruckner:

settings.suffixInvalid: Fingerprint and ModelTrace take a model without a reasoning effort suffix
settings.runsInvalid: Runs per credential must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}
settings.concurrencyInvalid: Concurrency must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}

quality.unsupported: This credential does not serve the chosen model

quality.clearAllMessage: This deletes all test records of every credential and cannot be undone. Tests in progress go on and still save their results.
quality.clearCorruptMessage: The history file cannot be read, so saving is paused. Clearing renames it (.corrupt-<time>) and starts saving from empty records; tests in progress go on.

fingerprint.differentHint: The actual model cannot be determined
fingerprint.partial: Based on the samples collected before it ended; for reference only.
fingerprint.alphaNote: A smaller distance means closer answer distributions. A p-value below {{alpha}} counts as a significant difference; attribution weighs both the distance and the test.

fingerprint.noProbes: Too few valid samples to compare any probe

modeltrace.failedHint: See the details for the reason

recordError.streamEnded: The model response stream ended before it completed

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Luobo's modules, hook timings, data files and runtime state.
settings.moduleErrorsLead: These modules could not open their data files and are off; fix or move the file, then restart CPA:
settings.hooksHint: Time Luobo spends in each host hook. Count and max cover the time since the plugin process started; p50/p99 cover each hook's latest 512 calls.
settings.ownerYes: Yes, this instance writes the data
settings.notOwner: This instance does not own the data directory: management writes are refused and the new instance owns the data.
settings.readOnly: After a rolled-back hot replacement this instance could not take the data directory back (another instance may still hold its lock), so management writes are refused. It recovers on the next CPA config apply once the lock is free, or after a CPA restart.
